stories.title: UP all-rounder’s runs cost ₹15 lakh each:Rinku Singh and Deepak Chahar among IPL 2026's biggest disappointments
stories.summary: The 19th edition of the Indian Premier League concludes on May 31, with more than 10 players from Uttar Pradesh featuring in the tournament. Among them, all eyes were on Prashant Veer and Rinku Singh. The spotlight on Prashant was due to the hefty ₹14.20 crore bid Chennai Super Kings (CSK) paid for the all-rounder, while Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) retained Rinku Singh for ₹13 crore. However, neither player lived up to expectations. Prashant endured a difficult campaign, with every run he scored effectively costing over ₹15 lakh. Rinku's season was also considered average. Among UP's newer players, only Mohsin Khan delivered a notable performance, while most others struggled to make a significant impact. Among the experienced campaigners, 37-year-old Bhuvneshwar Kumar stood out, helping Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) reach the final with his impressive bowling performances. Prashant Veer: Every run cost more than ₹15 lakh Prashant Veer hails from Gujjipur village, around 15 kilometres from Amethi district headquarters. Until the morning of December 16, few people knew his name. By evening, he had become a national talking point. CSK signed the 20-year-old for a staggering ₹14.20 crore, making him the most expensive uncapped player in IPL history. Despite the price tag, Prashant is yet to play international cricket. His first appearance came against Punjab on April 3, where he remained unbeaten on 6 from 7 balls. In the following match against Bangalore, he showed promise with a 43-run knock off 29 deliveries when his side was under pressure. It remained his highest score of the season. However, his performances dipped afterwards. In the next three matches, he managed scores of 18, 13 and 11. As an all-rounder, he was also expected to contribute with the ball. Against Mumbai, he conceded 25 runs in two overs without taking a wicket. Overall, Prashant faced 67 balls and scored 91 runs during the season. Based on his auction price, each run effectively cost CSK around ₹15.6 lakh. Sameer Rizvi: Price fell from ₹8.40 crore to ₹95 lakh Meerut's Sameer Rizvi was one of the biggest stories of IPL 2024 when CSK bought him for ₹8.40 crore. At the time, he was relatively unknown outside domestic cricket. However, he scored only 51 runs in five innings across eight matches, prompting CSK to release him ahead of the 2025 season. Delhi Capitals acquired him for ₹95 lakh in 2025. He responded with 121 runs in five matches, earning retention for IPL 2026. Rizvi began the season strongly. He scored 70 from 47 balls in his opening match and followed it up with a match-winning 90 off 51 balls against Mumbai Indians. Those performances suggested he was set for a breakthrough campaign. Instead, he was dismissed first ball in the next match and struggled to maintain consistency thereafter. Rizvi finished the season with 252 runs from 11 matches. Notably, nearly 65% of those runs came in his first two innings. Vipraj Nigam fails to bon early promise Twenty-two-year-old Vipraj Nigam, from Barabanki district, joined Delhi Capitals in 2025 for ₹50 lakh. He made an immediate impact on debut against Lucknow Super Giants, smashing 39 runs from just 15 balls, including five fours and two sixes, helping Delhi secure victory. The innings quickly made him one of the tournament's emerging names. Delhi retained him for the 2026 season at the same price, but opportunities were limited. Vipraj played five matches, claiming only two wickets. Against Gujarat Titans, he conceded 23 runs in a single over. Against Punjab Kings, he gave away 24 runs in two overs, while Kolkata Knight Riders scored 34 runs from his two overs. He batted only twice during the season, scoring 12 runs on one occasion and remaining unbeaten on 3 in the other. Mohsin Khan delivers despite injury concerns Mohsin Khan, from Sambhal district, made his List-A debut for Uttar Pradesh in 2018. Mumbai Indians signed him at his base price in both the 2018 and 2020 auctions, but he did not play a single match. Lucknow Super Giants picked him up for ₹20 lakh in 2022, and he immediately impressed by taking 14 wickets in nine matches. LSG later retained him for ₹4 crore. After missing IPL 2025 through injury, Mohsin returned strongly in 2026. He claimed 11 wickets in seven matches, including remarkable figures of 5 for 23 against KKR. He became the first uncapped player to take a five-wicket haul in an IPL innings. Regularly bowling at speeds above 140 kmph, Mohsin remains one of UP's most exciting pace prospects, although fitness concerns continue to limit his appearances. Dhruv Jurel emerges as Rajasthan's key performer Agra's Dhruv Jurel was retained by Rajasthan Royals for ₹14 crore after joining the franchise at the same price in 2025. The wicketkeeper-batter became one of Rajasthan's most important players this season. Across 16 matches, Jurel scored 515 runs at a strike rate of 154.65. He registered six half-centuries and struck 46 fours and 24 sixes. Beyond his batting, Jurel also played a leadership role behind the stumps and was frequently seen directing field placements. Rinku Singh's season ends on an average note Aligarh's Rinku Singh, a long-serving KKR player, endured a modest campaign. In 14 matches, he scored 295 runs and registered two half-centuries. His tally included 27 fours and 11 sixes. KKR struggled early in the season, failing to win any of their first six matches. Although they recovered by winning six of their next seven games, it was not enough to keep their playoff hopes alive, and they finished seventh in the points table. Retained for ₹13 crore, Rinku was unable to produce the match-winning consistency expected of him. Deepak Chahar's decline continues Agra pacer Deepak Chahar has long been one of the IPL's most sought-after bowlers. After earning ₹14 crore with CSK between 2022 and 2024, he joined Mumbai Indians in 2025 for ₹9.25 crore and remained with the franchise this season. However, his struggles continued. Chahar managed only eight wickets in eight matches. Against Rajasthan Royals, he conceded 22 runs in a single over. Against Punjab Kings, he gave away 45 runs in 15 deliveries. Mumbai endured a disappointing season, losing 10 of their 14 matches and finishing ninth in the standings. Kuldeep and Shami deliver average campaigns Kanpur spinner Kuldeep Yadav was retained by Delhi Capitals for ₹13.20 crore. Despite his reputation as one of India's leading spinners, he managed only 10 wickets in 11 matches. In eight games, his economy rate exceeded 10 runs per over. Kuldeep remains a proven performer internationally, having taken 95 wickets in 54 T20Is for India at an economy rate of 6.95. Meanwhile, Amroha's Mohammed Shami moved from Sunrisers Hyderabad to Lucknow Super Giants for ₹10 crore ahead of the season. He claimed 12 wickets in 13 matches. His best figures came against Hyderabad, where he took 2 for 9 in four overs. Overall, his performances were viewed as average. Bhuvneshwar Kumar leads Bangalore into the final Among UP's senior players, Bhuvneshwar Kumar enjoyed the most successful season. The Meerut-born fast bowler took 26 wickets in 15 matches for Royal Challengers Bangalore. He also claimed five hat-tricks during the campaign. One of his standout performances came against Delhi, where he took three wickets while conceding just five runs in three overs. Against Mumbai, he picked up four wickets. By consistently striking early, Bhuvneshwar helped RCB gain control of matches and played a crucial role in their journey to the final. Having been retained for ₹10.75 crore, he fully justified the franchise's faith in him. Expert View: UP's young talent is being prepared for the future Senior sports journalist Suraj Pandey believes UP's emerging players are still developing and could have brighter futures ahead. "Prashant Veer and Mohsin Khan are preparing for the future. Chennai sees Prashant as a long-term replacement for Ravindra Jadeja. His performances were not outstanding this season, but he has the potential to improve significantly," Pandey said. On Mohsin, he added: "Injury problems have held him back. Otherwise, there are very few bowlers of his quality. This season he bowled 12 deliveries to Vaibhav Suryavanshi and conceded only two runs, despite Vaibhav being one of the most dangerous batters around." Discussing Sameer Rizvi and Vipraj Nigam, Pandey said Rizvi almost single-handedly won Delhi's first two matches before losing momentum. He also felt Vipraj deserved more opportunities, given his ability to contribute with both bat and ball. As for Rinku Singh and Deepak Chahar, Pandey believes both fell short of expectations. "Rinku received plenty of chances but could not convert them into big performances. Deepak's form has been declining consistently over the last three IPL seasons," he said.

stories.title: Ghaziabad student’s murder accused Asad killed in police encounter:Father also arrested; Allegedly instigated killing on Bakrid
stories.summary: The main accused in the murder of Class 11 student Surya Chauhan in Ghaziabad has been killed in a police encounter. According to police, the accused, Asad, was attempting to flee the city when officers intercepted him at around 4 am on Sunday. Police surrounded him in the Vasundhara area, but he allegedly opened fire. Officers retaliated, and Asad was shot dead in the exchange. Police had announced a ₹50,000 reward for information leading to his arrest on Saturday. Surya was stabbed to death on Bakrid 17-year-old Surya was attacked and killed on Bakrid. According to a minor friend who witnessed the incident, Asad called Surya and asked him to meet him. Once there, Surya was allegedly surrounded by Asad and his associates, who repeatedly stabbed him. The friend claimed that before the attack, Asad asked Surya, "Bakra halal hote hue dekha hai kabhi? Aao dikhate hai” CCTV footage related to the incident had also surfaced during the investigation. Surya succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment on Friday afternoon. Case triggered tension and protests As the case involved members of two different communities, it quickly attracted widespread attention. On Saturday, members of Hindu organisations staged protests and took to the streets demanding action. Surya's family initially refused to perform the last rites and protested for nearly 10 hours. Police officials eventually persuaded the family, and the cremation was carried out later in the evening. Political leaders demanded action Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya had earlier said that the killer would not be spared, regardless of who was responsible. Bahujan Samaj Party chief Mayawati also demanded strict action against those involved in the crime. Meanwhile, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath chaired a meeting with district magistrates across the state on Saturday amid concerns over rising crime. Mother demands proof of encounter Surya's mother, Saroj, said she wanted to see evidence that Asad had indeed been killed in the encounter. "I have only seen one person involved in the encounter, but I want to see Asad's photograph. The police have not shown me his picture yet. Only after seeing it will I be satisfied," she said. She further demanded similar action against the remaining accused. "Seven people were involved in killing my son. The same action should be taken against all of them. Bulldozers should also be used against their houses," she said. Family yet to comment on meeting CM When asked whether the family planned to meet Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Saroj declined to comment. "We will not say anything right now. If and when we meet him, we will speak about it afterwards," she said. In an earlier conversation with Dainik Bhaskar on Saturday, she had demanded police encounters against the accused and demolition action against their properties.

stories.summary: Surya Murder Case: ‘बकरीद के दिन मेरे मासूम बेटे की बलि दे दी गई… अब मुझे बस इंसाफ चाहिए, आरोपी असद की लाश मेरे सामने लाओ।’ यह चीख गाजियाबाद के खोड़ा इलाके की उस बेबस मां की है, जिसके 11वीं में पढ़ने वाले बेटे सूर्या चौहान की चाकू गोदकर हत्या कर दी गई। सूर्या का शव घर पहुंच चुका है, लेकिन रोती-बिलखती मां और गुस्से से भरे परिजनों ने उसका अंतिम संस्कार करने से साफ मना कर दिया है। पीड़ित मां ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ से गुहार लगाते हुए कहा है कि जब तक मुख्य आरोपी असद का पुलिस एनकाउंटर नहीं करेगी, तब तक बेटे का दाह संस्कार नहीं होगा।

stories.title: CM Yogi upset over rising crime in UP:Hold meeting with DMs and police chiefs from 8 districts; ACP and 2 inspectors removed in Lucknow
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is understood to be deeply concerned over a series of major criminal incidents reported across the state in recent days. On Saturday, the Chief Minister unexpectedly summoned officials from districts with high crime rates and reportedly reprimanded them during a review meeting held via video conference. The meeting lasted for around 40 minutes. Commissioners and District Magistrates attend review meeting The meeting was attended by the commissioners and district magistrates of Lucknow, Varanasi, Ghaziabad and Noida. District magistrates and police chiefs from Ghazipur, Jaunpur, Pilibhit and Baghpat also joined the review. Several high-profile murder cases have been reported in these districts in recent weeks. During the meeting, the Chief Minister took note of the murder of Lucknow-based property dealer Sandeep Singh and directed officials to take strict action. Immediate action taken against police officers Soon after the meeting concluded, action was taken against two police station heads in Lucknow's eastern zone. Police Commissioner Amarendra Sengar transferred Inspector Amar Singh, Station House Officer of Vibhuti Khand police station, and the Inspector of Gomti Nagar Extension police station to the police lines. In addition, Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Vinay Dwivedi of Vibhuti Khand was removed from his post. Soumya Pandey has been appointed to take charge in his place. Recent murders have triggered CM's anger According to sources, the Chief Minister was particularly upset over several recent murder cases across the state. These include- Sources said the frequency and seriousness of these incidents prompted the Chief Minister to seek explanations from district officials and direct them to strengthen law-and-order measures. Now know about the incidents that have angered Yogi Property dealer was shot dead in Lucknow On the afternoon of May 27 (Wednesday) in Lucknow, a property dealer, Sandeep Singh, was shot dead. He was talking on his mobile phone in front of his office when miscreants opened fire on him. Nearby people admitted the property dealer to the Apex Trauma Center, where he died during treatment. Property dealer Sandeep Singh was a resident of Jaunpur. Jaunpur groom killed after stopping the wedding procession Azad, son of Ramlakhan, a resident of Badhaur village in Jaunpur, was to get married on May 22. Azad worked in a private company in Pune. His wedding procession (baraat) left at 8 PM for Bibipur village, 20 km away, in the Khetasarai police station area. There were three vehicles in the procession. The groom was in one, and family members were in the other two vehicles. Azad Bind was sitting in the front seat of the car, using his mobile phone. The car was parked on the side of the road. Suddenly, two people arrived on an Apache bike. Their faces were covered with scarves (gamcha), and they were wearing sunglasses even at night. The bike's number plate was also covered with cloth. They knocked on the car window. As soon as the window rolled down, the youth sitting at the back fired indiscriminately. Azad died in this incident. Son of millionaire hotelier murdered in Ghazipur The 29-year-old son of a millionaire hotelier was shot dead in Ghazipur. On the night of May 29 (Friday), four masked assailants surrounded him at the hotel gate and shot him four times. The four assailants arrived on 2 bikes under the pretext of buying beer. The attack occurred when Vineet, son of hotel owner Alok Rai, was leaving for home. As he was moving towards his car, the assailants started firing at Vineet with two pistols. He was shot once in the hand and once in the waist, while two bullets hit his chest. The miscreants also chased the guard to kill him. He saved his life by fleeing. After this, the miscreants fled while firing in the air. The guard telephoned the hotel owner and informed him. Vineet was taken to the medical college, where he died during treatment. In this case, Sadar Kotwal Mahendra Singh has been sent to the police line.

stories.title: International Para Athlete Chirag Tyagi murdered:Fellow competitor shoots him dead in Ghaziabad; Was returning home after winning gold
stories.summary: International Indian para athlete Chirag Tyagi was allegedly murdered in Ghaziabad on Saturday. Police said the accused is fellow para athlete Yash Khatik, who has confessed to the crime during questioning. The incident took place while Chirag was returning home after winning a gold medal at the Indian Open Para Athletics International Championship in Bengaluru. His victory had also secured his qualification for the upcoming Asian Para Games. Chirag's body was found at Sai Upvan in the Hindon area. He had suffered a gunshot wound to the back. A resident of Ghaziabad, Chirag competed in the 100m and 400m events and had represented India at national and international competitions, earning recognition for his achievements. Police question family, coach and girlfriend Assistant Commissioner of Police Upasana Pandey said investigators questioned Chirag's girlfriend, coach and family members as part of the probe. Based on CCTV footage and other evidence, police detained Yash Khatik. During interrogation, he allegedly admitted to killing Chirag. What CCTV footage revealed According to the police investigation and CCTV footage, Chirag travelled from Delhi to Hindon in an Ola cab along with a friend. The two then went to Sai Upvan, where Chirag was later shot dead. Using the CCTV footage, police identified and detained Yash Khatik, a resident of Muradnagar. Qualification dispute led to murder, police say Deputy Commissioner of Police Dhawal Jaiswal said Yash Khatik told investigators that he was also a para athlete and had previously trained alongside Chirag. The two had competed in several events together. According to police, during a document verification process for a competition, Chirag lodged a complaint against Yash. As a result, Yash's qualification was cancelled. Police believe Yash had been harbouring resentment since then and planned the attack to take revenge. Investigators said he allegedly shot Chirag with a pistol and fled the scene. Following a complaint by the family, police have registered a murder case. Efforts are underway to recover the weapon used in the crime based on information provided by the accused. Returning home after winning gold The 8th Indian Open Para Athletics International Championship was held at Sri Kanteerava Stadium in Bengaluru from May 26 to 28. Six para athletes from Ghaziabad won medals at the event and qualified for the upcoming Asian Para Games. The Asian Para Games are scheduled to be held in Japan from October 18 to 24. District Para Association secretary Monu Kumar said Chirag won a gold medal in the 400m event and a silver medal in the 1,500m race at the championship. He was returning home after these achievements when he was allegedly killed. Uncle says he called in the morning to say he was coming home Chirag’s uncle, Rajesh Tyagi, said, My nephew last called home at 8:10 a.m. He said he was on his way home. He first called his father, but when the call was not answered, he informed my younger brother.Whenever Chirag came home from Delhi, he would always call in advance and let us know he was coming. But today, after Chirag’s call, we received a call from the police informing us that his body had been found. Police are investigating it as a murder case. We do not suspect anyone. ACP Upasana Pandey said that the motive behind the murder is not yet clear. Police are investigating all possible angles and examining CCTV footage from the surrounding area. The exact cause of death will become clear after the post-mortem report is received. Only son in the family Manoj Tyagi, a farmer from Basantpur Sethli village in Ghaziabad’s Muradnagar area, is Chirag’s father. Chirag was his only son. His uncle Deepak Tyagi said, A week ago, Chirag had gone to Bengaluru for a training camp. After staying there for a week, he reached Delhi on May 29 and stayed at Nehru Stadium. I spoke to him on the phone this morning. He told me that he would reach home by 3 p.m. However, his mobile phone was switched off later in the afternoon. After that, Kotwali police from Ghaziabad informed us that something had happened to Chirag and asked us to come to the police station. There we learned that he had been murdered. His body was found near Sai Upvan in the Kotwali area. The uncle said it was clearly a murder and that the family had no known enmity with anyone in the village or elsewhere. On learning about their son’s death, father Manoj Tyagi and mother Nisha Tyagi were left devastated. Know about Chirag’s achievements Chirag Tyagi was one of India’s promising para runners. He represented Uttar Pradesh at the national level and mainly participated in running events under the T12 category, which is designated for athletes with visual impairments. Chirag Tyagi competed in the T12 category The T12 category is for para athletes who have severe visual impairment but are not completely blind. An object that a person with normal vision can easily see from 60 meters away may require a T12 athlete to be within about 2 meters or less to see clearly. These athletes can see objects directly in front of them to some extent, but their side vision is significantly limited. Their field of vision can be so narrow that it is comparable to looking through a thin tunnel.

stories.title: Massive fire breaks out at auto parts factory in Noida:Smoke visible from 4 km away; 35 fire tenders at spot
stories.summary: A massive fire suddenly broke out on Saturday evening at the Spark Minda company located in Sector-59, Noida. As soon as the fire started, there was chaos in the factory premises and the surrounding area. Thick smoke rising from the fire was visible up to 4 kilometers away. After the fire broke out, employees and other people present in the company premises were immediately evacuated to safety. As a precautionary measure, nearby companies were also alerted, and security arrangements were increased. Upon receiving information about the incident, 35 fire brigade vehicles reached the spot. Firefighters are continuously trying to control the fire. Pradeep Choubey, CFO of the Fire Department, said, The fire is on the ground floor and first floor. Chemicals and thinners were kept here. Due to this, the fire is spreading. That's why we are using the latest technology to extinguish the fire. We have also checked inside. No one is trapped inside. There were five people whose condition deteriorated due to suffocation. They were immediately sent for first aid. Currently, they have also been discharged. There is no loss of life. See pictures Tool parts are manufactured at Spark Minda company in Sector-59. At the time of the fire, 500-600 employees were working in the company. On Friday evening, around 6:30 PM, the fire alarm started ringing, following which a stampede ensued. The fire brigade was immediately informed. Initially, 5 fire tenders reached the spot, but seeing the escalating fire, 20 fire brigade vehicles are engaged in extinguishing the fire. Currently, the causes of the fire are not clear. A short circuit or some technical fault is suspected to be the cause of the fire. However, officials have stated that the actual causes will only be known after the fire is completely brought under control. Local police and fire department teams are present at the scene. Relief and rescue operations are being carried out by creating a security cordon in the surrounding area. No casualties reported so far According to officials, the good news is that no casualties have been reported so far. The extent of the damage will be assessed after the fire is brought under control. Currently, the fire department's operation is ongoing, and the situation is being continuously monitored.

stories.title: 'If my govt is formed, MBBS will cost just ₹1':Chandrashekhar says law engineering studies will be free
stories.summary: Chandrashekhar Azad on Saturday announced that if his party forms the government in Uttar Pradesh, MBBS education would cost just ₹1, while law and engineering courses would be made free. He also promised equal education for all students from Classes 1 to 12, saying free education is his party’s core pledge, similar to the BJP’s Ram Mandir commitment. Speaking at the urn site of B. R. Ambedkar on Vidhan Sabha Marg in Lucknow, the Nagina MP also launched the ‘Satta Parivartan Yatra’ (Power Change Journey) and said the Tamil Nadu election results have shown that political change is possible in Uttar Pradesh. Read 5 major points stated by Chandrashekhar 1. Government should conduct free entrance exams for youth Paper leaks should be treated as organized crime, with punishments as strict as those for murder, as they destroy students' futures and parents' dreams. The government should provide free entrance exams and home-centre facilities for aspirants. Equal education will be ensured from Classes 1 to 12. Just as BJP's resolution was Ram Mandir, our resolution is free education. If our government is formed, MBBS education will cost ₹1, while law and engineering courses will be completely free. Our goal is to employ youth. 2. Doors of alliance open for everyone Our mission is ‘Give jobs or leave the chair.’ Youth want employment, not corruption. The government is avoiding local body elections because it fears electoral defeat. We are preparing to contest all 403 assembly seats, but our doors remain open for alliances. We will provide reservation in promotions for SC/ST/OBCs, 15% additional reservation for extremely backward castes, reservation for backward classes in Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, and 50% reservation for women. The Old Pension Scheme will be restored, while farmers will get crop-loss compensation and MSP guarantees. Prepaid meters were withdrawn because of our agitation and pressure in Parliament. The government may reintroduce smart meters after elections, which is why it must be removed from power. 3. Will start the power change from Bijnor 'Vyavastha Parivartan Diwas' will be observed on June 4, and the 'Satta Parivartan Yatra' will begin from Bijnor. The 2027 campaign will be fought under the slogan 'Bahujan Hitay, Bahujan Sukhay.' The government has completed nine years in power, yet electricity tariffs have been increased by 10% despite record power cuts. This yatra is not just political but aims to protect the Constitution and secure the rights of backward classes, Dalits, and Muslims, who are facing the most injustice in UP. 4. Court asked for a list of mafias, now the Defense Minister should tell Chandrashekhar said Rajnath Singh speaks about ‘One District-One Mafia’ and CM Yogi's law and order. He urged him to reveal the mafia list sought by the court from the UP government and explain what kinds of mafias operate in the state. He said incidents of rape and murder continue to surface from UP, while the government keeps praising its law-and-order record. 5. 'Will temples from Mathura-Banaras be taken to Ayodhya?' Chandrashekhar said Babasaheb Ambedkar's urns were installed in front of the UP Assembly in 1991 and are now allegedly being tampered with. The site has been visited by former Chief Justices, Prime Ministers and Presidents. Questioning the move, he asked whether all religious sites could be brought to one place in the name of ‘Sarvajan’ and whether temples and deities from Mathura and Banaras could similarly be shifted to Ayodhya. Party spokesperson Aniket Dhanuk alleged that an attempt is being made to change the location of Ambedkar's urn on Vidhan Sabha Marg. He said the Azad Samaj Party will oppose the move from the streets to the Assembly, asserting that those who have problems with the Constitution are trying to remove Babasaheb's urn.

Weather experts have warned that drought-like conditions may develop in 10 districts of western Uttar Pradesh, while around 60 districts are expected to receive less rain than normal. 7. Missile strike on Israeli air base near Lebanon, claims Hezbollah Hezbollah has claimed responsibility for a missile attack targeting the air traffic control unit at Israel's Meron Air Control Base in northern Israel. 8. ‘Dhirendra Shastri should be given contract to predict the nation’s future ’, says Avimukteshwaranand Swami Avimukteshwaranand said that if spiritual leaders like Dhirendra Shastri claim to predict the future, the government should consult them for advance warnings about national disasters. He remarked that if such claims are true, it would be in the nation's interest to use that knowledge. Taking a dig at Yogi Adityanath, he added that merely wearing saffron robes does not make someone a saint. 9. Hindu student murdered in Ghaziabad, Dy CM vows action The murder of 17-year-old Surya Chauhan in Ghaziabad has triggered protests by Hindu organisations, which took to the streets on Saturday and demonstrated against the administration. Heavy police deployment has been made in the area, while many shopkeepers shut their businesses amid tensions. 10. Gold and silver witness decline this week Gold and silver prices declined this week. According to the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA), the price of 10 grams of 24 carat gold fell by ₹1,654 to ₹1.56 lakh.

stories.title: Electricity becomes costlier in UP, 10% fuel surcharge hiked:₹100 bill to rise to ₹110 from June; consumers call it open loot’
stories.summary: Amid an ongoing power crisis in Uttar Pradesh, electricity consumers are set to face higher bills from June. The Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) has ordered the implementation of a 10% Fuel and Power Purchase Adjustment Surcharge (FPPAS). The surcharge will increase electricity bills by 10%, meaning a bill of ₹100 will now cost ₹110. The move has drawn criticism from the Consumer Council, which has expressed displeasure and demanded the immediate withdrawal of the order. Why electricity prices increased According to the electricity department, a fuel surcharge has been imposed due to the additional cost incurred in generating and purchasing electricity, so that this can be compensated. Amidst the Middle East crisis, fuel prices are skyrocketing. Prices of petrol, diesel, and other commodities have increased. Meanwhile, electricity prices have also increased in UP. Actually, FPPAS (Fuel and Power Purchase Adjustment Surcharge) means that when the cost of fuel used in electricity generation or the cost of purchasing electricity increases, then this additional charge is added to consumers' bills to compensate for it. Consumer Council President said - Expensive electricity will break the back Awadhesh Kumar Verma, president of the Uttar Pradesh State Electricity Consumer Council, has opposed the electricity price hike, saying consumers are already burdened by extreme heat, power shortages and inflation. He noted that a 10% fuel surcharge was already recovered in February 2026, and the latest increase would further strain households. Verma claimed that while the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (UPERC) approved a power purchase cost of ₹4.94 per unit in its tariff order, the Power Corporation purchased electricity in March 2026 at around ₹5.86 per unit, imposing an additional burden of about ₹1,610 crore on consumers. He demanded an investigation into why such costly power was purchased and from which private generating companies it was procured. He also alleged that electricity is being consistently bought from private producers at higher rates and that around ₹1,400 crore in previous claims has been added to the March fuel surcharge. Consumer Council said that the order should be immediately stopped The Consumer Council says that the state's power companies already have a surplus of more than 51 thousand crore rupees from consumers. In such a situation, the entire matter should have been placed before the Electricity Regulatory Commission before imposing the burden of additional electricity tariffs. CM Yogi and the Energy Minister are demanded to immediately stop the 10% fuel surcharge being implemented based on February and March 2026. A high-level and impartial investigation of the entire matter should be conducted.

stories.title: 'Dhirendra Shastri should be given contract to predict Nation’s future':Shankaracharya adds 'Cockroach Party' symbolizes public anger against the govt
stories.summary: Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand said that people like Dhirendra Shastri, who hold public courts and claim to predict the future, should also be entrusted with predicting the country's future. He said that Dhirendra Shastri himself claims that if the Ministry of Defence contacts him, he can provide advance information about impending disasters. Therefore, the government should get in touch with him in the interest of the nation and its people. Taking a swipe at Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, the Shankaracharya said that merely wearing saffron robes does not make someone a saint. He added that ordering bulldozer action against people cannot be considered the work of a saint. He also described the “Cockroach Janata Party” as a symbol of public anger against government policies. Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand made these remarks while speaking to reporters in Jhansi on Saturday. He had arrived in the city on Friday night. He is currently leading a campaign seeking recognition of the cow as the “Rashta Mata.” As part of the campaign, he administered an oath to devotees at Kunj Bihari Temple in Jhansi, urging them to support only those political parties that promise in their election manifestos to declare the cow as the “Rashta Mata”. He later left for Jalaun. Now read the key points from Shankaracharya's press conference 1- Only talks happen in the name of cow protection Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand said that talks are only being done in the name of cow protection. Talks only sound good to hear, but they have no connection with reality. How good these talks sound that the government has made a provision of 2 thousand crores for cows in the budget. When their Animal Husbandry Minister came, he said on camera that we are building shelters for 12 lakh cows, we are working day and night for them. The Chief Minister said on camera that in my state, no one can even scratch a cow. But on the ground, the claims fall flat. Cows are forced to roam the streets for food. 2- Running bulldozers on people is not the conduct of a saint Shankaracharya said that if Yogi Adityanath considers himself a sadhu, then he should behave like a sadhu. One doesn't become a sadhu merely by wearing saffron clothes. I want to ask the CM to tell what behavior of his is like that of sadhus. Does a sadhu run a bulldozer over someone? He gets bulldozers to run over people. If someone is a sadhu and has come to power, then he should first protect cows. His government has been there for so many days, I want to ask why cow slaughter hasn't stopped yet. Why are cows decreasing in Uttar Pradesh? Why is the condition of the shelters that have been built so poor? 3- Behind Cockroach Party are those people who are troubled by govt policies He said that for those who want to do politics, there is always scope. A new party can be formed with the name Cockroach or any other name. Anyone can register with a party name, but we need to see how many people have gathered behind them. These people are troubled by government policies. They want this government to be removed; that's why they have gathered. 4- Some people came to Kumbh only to make reels Two types of people are always found in society. One, those who consider religion as a means, and second, those who consider it as an end. People who consider religion as an end think that we only need to attain God, and nothing else. But people who consider religion as a means use it to fulfill their aspirations and desires. Such people have always existed. To protect from them and show people the right path, virtuous people have to make continuous efforts. In Kumbh too, some people had come only to make reels; they could see only that they were there. At that time, we had also said that many accomplished saints were also present there. Did you not see them? Were they not a subject of TRP for you? 5- Dhirendra Shastri's support for declaring Gau Mata as Rashtra Mata Acharya Dhirendra Shastri is currently doing penance in Badrinath. This information has come to light through the media. He has said that he will soon organize some events to get Gau Mata the status of Rashtra Mata. Voices are now gradually rising from various quarters regarding the demand to declare Gau Mata as Rashtra Mata.

stories.title: Student murdered in Ghaziabad, Dy CM vows action:Hindu outfits protest over killers' shocking remark linked to Bakrid
stories.summary: The murder of 17-year-old Surya Chauhan in Ghaziabad has triggered protests by Hindu organisations, which took to the streets on Saturday and demonstrated against the administration. Heavy police deployment has been made in the area, while many shopkeepers shut their businesses amid tensions. Surya’s body was brought home around 2 PM after the post-mortem. His mother broke down on seeing the body, and the family refused to perform the last rites, saying the cremation will not take place until the accused are killed in an encounter. The body has been kept in a deep freezer. Killers would not be spared - DCM Keshav Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Maurya said the killers would not be spared and that all legal action necessary to ensure strict punishment would be taken. BSP chief Mayawati also demanded stringent action against the accused. According to police, Surya was allegedly stabbed to death by his Muslim friends on Bakrid. A minor witness said the accused lured him to a meeting over an old rivalry, asked if he had ever seen a goat being slaughtered, and then repeatedly attacked him with knives. Surya managed to run nearly 200 metres before the attackers caught up and assaulted him again. Police registered an FIR against five Locals rushed to the spot after hearing his screams, forcing the accused to flee. Surya was taken to a private hospital in Noida, where he died during treatment. Based on a complaint by his elder brother, Yash Chauhan, police registered an FIR against five people, including the main accused, Asad. Three accused have been arrested, while police are searching for Asad and another suspect. The incident took place on May 28 in Navneet Vihar under the Khoda police station area. See pictures Understand the entire case sequentially Murder to avenge an 8-month-old dispute Surya's friend said that about 8 months ago, Asad was fighting with a boy. Then Surya intervened. He told Asad not to fight and rescued the boy from Asad's clutches. Asad was very angry about this. At that time, Asad had told Surya, 'Why are you interfering? You will have to face the consequences.' The family members have demanded strict action against the accused, including bulldozer action and an encounter. As a precautionary measure, heavy police force has been deployed in the area. According to the police, the accused are being searched with the help of CCTV and surveillance. Soon, the accused will be in police custody. DCP Dhaval Jaiswal stated-- The preliminary reason that has come to light in this case is that all these people were known to each other. They were all friends. On that day, they had a dispute over riding a bike, during which one youth, in a fit of rage, stabbed the other. The inquest (panchnama) and post-mortem procedures of the body have been completed. The body has been handed over to the family. Further legal action will be taken. Surya Chauhan was a worker of Hindu Rakshadal Khoda Hindu Rakshadal President Sonu Sharma said, Surya Chauhan was a worker of Hindu Rakshadal. If such a massacre happens in Yogi Adityanath's rule, it will not be tolerated at all. We will put up 'migration' boards here. This is not the first incident. Even before this, Jats have migrated from here. Our demand is that those jihadis should be encountered. Their houses should be bulldozed. Mayawati advises govt and administration to take right steps Former CM and BSP supremo Mayawati expressed grief over the incident. She wrote on 'X' - The murder of a young man, Surya Chauhan, in Khoda, Ghaziabad, is extremely sad and worrying. To prevent such incidents that are happening daily, the government and administration need to take the right steps. Also, the criminals involved in this incident should be identified and given legal punishment. Along with this, as the election time approaches, such incidents will have widespread negative consequences. The government should be fully vigilant. Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said, No matter who the killer is, they will not be spared. They will be found. The legal action required to hang those who commit murder will be taken. The government is very serious about law and order. Strict legal action will be taken against those who have committed such a crime.

stories.summary: It is over one year since militants unleashed carnage in Kashmir’s Pahalgam, killing 26 tourists. stories.title: Bulldozers run over 15 new houses in Dalmandi:PWD takes action in Varanasi, 200 cops deployed to maintain law and order
stories.summary: In the Dalmandi area of Varanasi, after a break of several days, a demolition drive was carried out once again on Saturday. The PWD demolished 15 houses even as administration remained fully alert regarding the action and a heavy police force was deployed in the area. According to PWD officials, the owners of the houses that were demolished had already been given compensation. The demolition action was carried out after the registry process was completed. The drive had been suspended for a few days due to Bakrid, which was restarted from Saturday. Under the Dalmandi project, more than 60 houses have been demolished so far, while demolition work is ongoing on more than 40 buildings. Action is being taken in a phased manner against a total of 181 identified houses. Over 200 police personnel deployed To maintain law and order during the demolition drive, approximately 200 police personnel were deployed under the leadership of ACP Dashashwamedh Atul Anjan. Police officials kept surveillance across the entire area to prevent any untoward situation from arising. ACP Dashashwamedh Atul Anjan stated that adequate police force was deployed to ensure the PWD's action under the Dalmandi project was completed peacefully. The situation remained completely normal during the operation. Now know what is the Dalmandi Project PM Had Laid the Foundation Stone of the Project Varanasi's Dalmandi Gali is to be developed as a model road. The Prime Minister laid the foundation stone for this work during his 51st visit to Kashi. For this, the state government has released Rs 215.88 crore. 186 building and shop owners will be given Rs 191 crore as compensation. The road will be 60 feet wide According to PWD officials, the 650-meter Dalmandi Gali from Nayi Sadak to Chowk Thana is to be widened to 60 feet. It will have a 30-foot road and 15-foot footpaths on both sides. Electricity, sewer, and water systems will be laid underground. The tangle of wires here will be cleared. 650-meter long road to be built at a cost of ₹220 Cr The total length of Dalmandi from the new road to Chowk police station is 650 meters. The draft to widen this road to 17.5 meters has been passed. For this, a budget of 215 crores was approved on the last day of the financial year 2024-25 and 2 crore rupees have also been released. The PWD team measured how wide the road is at each location, which house falls within how much area, and after measuring 181 houses, their registration began and demolition work has started. Apart from this, there are also 6 mosques in this area. PWD officials prepared the data. Based on this data, compensation was assessed, which is approximately 191 crore rupees. So far, more than 60 houses have been registered. Gradually, the demolition of houses is being carried out.

stories.title: Rajeev Krishna to become UP's permanent DGP:Name cleared after 4-year wait; official order expected soon
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is set to get a permanent Director General of Police (DGP) after a four-year wait. The current acting DGP, Rajeev Krishna, will be the new permanent DGP of UP. After a high-level meeting of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) held in Delhi on May 26, the final panel of three officers has been sent to the state government. According to sources, the state government may soon issue an official order appointing Rajeev Krishna as the permanent DGP. Names of these 3 senior IPS in UPSC panel According to sources, UPSC has sent a panel of three officers to the UP government based on seniority: 1. Renuka Mishra (1990 Batch): Her name is at the top in terms of seniority. She has been without any charge (waiting) for the past two years. However, the UP government had deemed her 'unsuitable' for this post, but UPSC disregarded the government's argument and included her name in the panel. 2. Piyush Anand (1991 Batch): He is at number two. Currently, he is on central deputation and serving as the DG of NDRF (National Disaster Response Force). 3. Rajiv Krishna (1991 Batch): He is at number three in the panel. Since Rajiv Krishna is the government's first choice, his appointment as permanent DGP is considered certain. 5 'Acting' DGPs changed in a year In the history of UP Police, the recent past has relied on acting captains. The state's last permanent DGP was Mukul Goel, who took charge on July 1, 2021, but was removed from the post on May 13, 2022. Since then, UP has seen a succession of acting DGPs: Only a formality remains Most officers senior to Rajeev Krishna have now retired. After the official UPSC panel arrives, the final approval of his name is now just a formality. The government can issue the government order (GO) for his permanent appointment at any time.

stories.title: Varanasi clears 280 tonnes of Bakrid waste:Collection completed from 79 sites; authorities prevent dumping across city
stories.summary: The Municipal Corporation carried out a special cleanliness drive across the city during Bakrid and made extensive arrangements for the collection and disposal of waste generated after animal sacrifices. To ensure timely waste removal, the civic body identified 79 locations across the city and deployed 94 vehicles. The collected waste was transported to the Karsada dumping station, where it was disposed of using scientific methods. Special cleaning operations were also carried out in the affected areas. Municipal Commissioner Himanshu Nagpal said that a large quantity of offal and other organic waste is usually generated in Muslim-majority localities during Bakrid. Keeping this in mind, the Municipal Corporation prepared a detailed action plan in advance this year. According to the commissioner, around 280 tonnes of waste were collected and disposed of from the 79 identified locations during Bakrid and the following day. The operation involved 94 vehicles, including DP containers, compactors, hoppers, Tata Ace vehicles, tractor-trolleys, loaders and dumpers. Scientific disposal in Karsada dumping yard According to the Municipal Commissioner, all waste was scientifically disposed of by digging pits in the Karsada dumping yard. For this, special organic pits were prepared, so that there would be no problem of disorder or foul smell. He informed that this time, no waste was dumped anywhere within the city limits. This also prevented potential impacts on the environment and public health. This time, temporary dumping was not done in the city According to municipal corporation officials, earlier, the waste generated during Bakrid used to be temporarily dumped near the Rajghat area and later disposed of. But this time, changing the entire system, the waste was directly transported to the Karsada dumping yard. Special cleaning drive conducted in neighbourhoods After waste collection, municipal corporation teams continuously engaged in cleaning work in streets and neighbourhoods. stories.title: Trump’s daughter Tiffany visits Taj Mahal with husband:Arrives directly from airport; clicks photos on Diana Bench; interacts with guide
stories.summary: American President Donald Trump’s daughter Tiffany Trump arrived in Agra on Saturday with her husband, Michael Boulos. The couple landed at Kheria Airport in a chartered aircraft at around 11:30 am and headed straight to the Taj Mahal for a private visit. Tiffany and Michael entered the Taj Mahal complex in a golf cart. They were accompanied by US Ambassador to India Sergio Gore and tourist guide Ramesh Dhawan. During the visit, Tiffany asked several questions about the monument, and the guide explained its history in detail. The couple later visited the famous Diana Bench, where they posed for photographs while holding hands. They spent nearly one and a half hours exploring the Taj Mahal and taking pictures from different spots inside the complex. After the visit, Tiffany and Michael left for Hotel Amar Vilas Palace. Their room offers a clear view of the Taj Mahal. Following lunch and a short rest at the hotel, the couple is scheduled to leave for Jaisalmer in Rajasthan later in the evening by chartered plane. See 3 pictures Trump family came to Agra in 2020 It is noteworthy that in 2020, President Donald Trump came to Agra to see the Taj Mahal with his wife, Melania Trump, daughter Ivanka Trump, and son-in-law Jared Kushner. After about 6 years, another member of the Trump family is reaching the city of Taj. Local administration and security agencies are fully alert regarding Tiffany Trump's visit. Police and intelligence agencies have been put on alert mode at Kheria Airport, hotels, Taj Mahal complex, and the entire route. Security agencies have increased surveillance of the hotel and monument complex. Learn about Tiffany Trump Tiffany Trump is the only daughter of American President Donald Trump's second wife, Marla Maples. Tiffany was born on October 13, 1993, in Florida. Tiffany married businessman Michael Boulos in 2022. In 2025, the couple had a son, named Alexander Trump Boulos. Tiffany Trump has appeared multiple times in her father's political campaigns and has also delivered speeches at the 2016 and 2020 Republican National Conventions. She studied Law (JD).

stories.title: Meerut man arrested for remarks against CM Yogi:70-year-old apologises at police station; pleads mistake and faces court appearance
stories.summary: Police in Meerut have arrested a 70-year-old man for allegedly making objectionable remarks against Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. After being taken to the police station, the accused apologised in front of officers by holding his ears and admitting his mistake. When police brought him out of the station, he was seen limping and repeatedly requested forgiveness. He said he would not repeat such an act. The accused is scheduled to be produced in court on Saturday. The incident took place on May 28, Bakrid day, after prayers at the Eidgah on Railway Road. During a conversation with journalists, the man allegedly made controversial remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. A video of the incident later surfaced on social media. Several people standing behind him were seen laughing at his comments. After the video went viral, police launched an investigation and identified the accused as Ehsan, a resident of the Delhi Gate area. Police detained Ehsan on Friday evening and brought him to the Railway Road police station. Further legal action is underway. Seen limping out of the police station, holding his ears According to the police, Ehsan is a scrap dealer by profession. He was arrested from his home in Delhi Gate. After his arrest, his behavior appeared completely changed. At the police station, he kept apologising, holding his ears. During interrogation, he stated that he had used hateful language in a fit of rage. When the police brought the accused out of the police station to brief the media after his arrest, the accused was limping. He held his ears in front of the media. He was seen walking with his head bowed. A case has been registered and legal action is being taken CO Cantt Navina Shukla said- On May 29, a video surfaced. In it, indecent and inappropriate remarks are being made against respected persons holding constitutional positions to disrupt social harmony. After investigating the video, teams were formed. Accused Ehsan has been arrested. A case has been registered against him and action is being taken.This picture is from outside Bahraich Kotwali. In which the Maulana was seen limping. The matter is from 2 months ago, i.e., March.The Maulana who abused Yogi's mother was also seen limpingEarlier, in March, Maulana Abdul Saleem Chaturvedi, who had used abusive language against CM Yogi's mother, was arrested by Bahraich police. While being taken from the police station to jail, the Maulana was seen limping and stooping. Policemen were seen supporting him. He had a mask on his face.A video of the Maulana had also surfaced. In it, he was seen apologizing with folded hands. He was saying - "During the speech, some objectionable things came out of my mouth, which should not have. For this, I sincerely apologize to the CM and his mother."The Maulana was arrested by UP STF from Purnia. The Maulana had made this indecent remark about 2 years ago, the video of which went viral on March 6. After this, Hindu organizations and BJP workers in UP protested in several districts including Lucknow and demanded action.Complaints had been filed against the Maulana in several districts, including Balrampur and Bahraich. On March 8, Ajit Pratap Singh, District President of the Legal Cell of Vishwa Hindu Parishad, had filed a case at Bahraich Kotwali. The police had brought the Maulana for questioning in this very case.A video surfaced after the Maulana's arrest. In it, he was seen apologizing with folded hands.Maulana said - the mistake will not be repeated The Maulana had stated that on May 5, 2024, an educational awareness conference was held in the Miran Chak area of Bhagalpur, Bihar. During his speech, objectionable remarks came out of his mouth. He had said that he made a mistake and assures that such a mistake will not be repeated in the future.

stories.title: 40 year old teacher dies after falling from bus:Loses balance near gate; conductor fails to pull her back
stories.summary: A female teacher from an inter-college in Sitapur died after falling from a moving bus in the Rampur Kalan area on Friday. She reportedly lost her balance while leaning out of the bus door to spit. According to eyewitnesses, the 40-year-old teacher had come near the bus gate during the journey. As she leaned out, she lost her balance and fell onto the road. The conductor reportedly tried to grab her, but was unable to prevent the fall. The bus was moving at high speed when the accident occurred. The teacher suffered severe head injuries and bled heavily on the road, triggering panic among passengers. The driver immediately stopped the bus, and the injured woman was rushed to a nearby hospital. However, doctors declared her dead on arrival. The deceased was employed as a teacher at an inter-college and was disabled in one hand. The accident took place in the Rampur Kalan area, around 42 km from the Sitapur district headquarters. Police have begun an investigation into the incident and are gathering details from passengers and bus staff. Now know the full story She was an assistant teacher in an intercollege Vibha Gupta (40 years old), a resident of Sarawgi Tola, Mahmoodabad, was an assistant teacher at the Government Girls Inter College in Pisawan. She was disabled in her right hand. She was also unmarried. Her family includes an elder brother and parents. On Friday morning, Vibha boarded a Roadways bus (UP 34 AT 3998) going from Mahmoodabad to Sitapur. She was going to a relative's house in Sidhauli. Vibha was sitting on the seat in front of the door in the bus. Around 1:30 PM, the bus reached the Biswan-Mahmudabad road in front of Patti village, under the Rampur Kalan police station area. After drinking water, Vibha came near the bus door to spit and stood there. The bus was moving at a high speed. Due to a jolt, she could not hold the handle properly. As soon as she lost her balance, she stumbled and fell off the bus. The conductor moved forward to catch her, but it was too late. As soon as the accident happened, there was chaos among the passengers sitting in the bus. The driver immediately stopped the bus. The police were informed. Police questioned the driver and conductor Upon receiving information about the incident, the Dial-112 team reached the spot. An ambulance was called, and the injured teacher was sent to the Community Health Centre, Pahla. There, doctors declared her dead. Police sent the body for a post-mortem. In the initial investigation, it is believed that the teacher fell from the bus due to a loss of balance. However, the police are investigating all aspects. The bus driver and conductor were also questioned. In-charge Inspector Lalla Goswami said, While spitting water, the woman suddenly lost her balance and fell down. She died due to serious injuries. The family has been informed about the accident. Passengers, the bus driver, and the conductor are also being questioned. Further action will be taken based on the family's complaint and the investigation.

stories.title: Yogi questions officer’s foreign trip after storm deaths:117 people died in UP; Chief Secretary asked to explain approval
stories.summary: A major controversy has erupted over the foreign tour of UP's Relief Commissioner, Dr. Hrishikesh Bhaskar Yashod. CM Yogi Adityanath has expressed strong displeasure over the Relief Commissioner going abroad amidst the death of 117 people due to a storm in the state on May 13. CM Yogi has sought an explanation from Chief Secretary SP Goyal for granting permission for the Relief Commissioner's foreign trip. It is being said that this is the first time that the CM has directly questioned the Chief Secretary for approving an officer's leave. PM Narendra Modi had appealed to ministers, officers, and countrymen on May 10 not to travel abroad for at least one year. After this, Yogi also reiterated PM Modi's statement in separate meetings with ministers and officers. Relief Commissioner was abroad for 9 days Relief Commissioner Dr. Hrishikesh Bhaskar Yashod worked half-day on May 14. After this, he went on a foreign trip from May 15 to May 23 (total 9 days). On May 13 itself, a severe storm hit several parts of the state. In this disaster, 117 people lost their lives and life was completely disrupted in many districts. See pictures of the storm that came on May 13 A neem tree fell on a car in Unnao. The storm was so strong that the bench flew into the air. When CM asked for a report, it was found that the 'Relief Commissioner' was not there According to sources, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath sought a report from the Relief Commissioner to review the distribution of relief material to people affected by the storm, the distribution of compensation to the families of the deceased, and other relief operations. When the report was not received, officials informed that Dr. Hrishikesh was abroad on a 9-day leave. When the CM investigated this, it came to light that Chief Secretary S.P. Goyal himself had given him the green light to go abroad. On this, the CM expressed displeasure with the Chief Secretary. According to the source, the Chief Minister told the Chief Secretary that on one hand, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has appealed to officials not to travel abroad without any solid reason, and on the other hand, the state has suffered such a huge loss of life due to a severe storm. Why and how was the Relief Commissioner granted permission to go abroad at such a sensitive time? Chief Secretary's argument - Leave was approved before the PM's appeal Chief Secretary SP Goyal, embroiled in the matter, has presented his side to the CM. Sources say that the Chief Secretary argued that Dr. Rishikesh Bhaskar Yashod had been granted permission to go abroad much before Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal, and therefore, he was not stopped. Relief Commissioner said - Ask where you got the information from On this whole matter, Relief Commissioner Dr. Rishikesh Bhaskar Yashod says- I will not tell you where I went, it is not related to me. Find out from where you got the information. .

stories.title: Drought-like conditions likely in Uttar Pradesh this year:Delayed monsoon, longer heatwaves threaten paddy cultivation
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is likely to receive below-normal rainfall during the 2026 monsoon season, raising concerns over agriculture and water availability. Weather experts have warned that drought-like conditions may develop in 10 districts of western Uttar Pradesh, while around 60 districts are expected to receive less rain than normal. A cyclonic circulation over western UP is expected to bring rain during the first week of June, offering temporary relief from the heat. However, temperatures are likely to rise sharply afterwards, leading to longer heatwave conditions. Experts say this could directly affect paddy cultivation, especially if farmers depend mainly on monsoon rainfall. Monsoon arrival in UP likely to be delayed The southwest monsoon usually reaches Kerala around June 1. This year, it was expected to arrive by May 26, nearly six days early. However, as of May 29, the monsoon remained about 30-35 kilometres away from the Kerala coast. While some rainfall has begun in the region, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has not yet declared the onset of the monsoon. The monsoon was earlier expected to reach Uttar Pradesh between June 18 and 20, but meteorologists now believe its arrival could be delayed. According to Atul Singh, senior scientist at the Regional Meteorological Centre in Lucknow, the monsoon is expected to remain weak this season, making it difficult to predict its exact arrival date in the state. UP may receive 8% less rainfall this season UP normally receives around 820-840 mm of rainfall during the monsoon months from June to September. However, the latest forecast suggests rainfall could be around 8% below normal this year, with total precipitation estimated at 754-773 mm. Meteorologists determine whether rainfall is normal, above normal or below normal using the Long Period Average (LPA), which is based on average rainfall data collected over the past 50 years. Cyclonic circulation to bring rain, storms and lightning A cyclonic circulation that formed over western Uttar Pradesh on May 28 is expected to bring thunderstorms, lightning and rain across several areas over the next two to three days. The weather system is likely to provide temporary relief from intense heat. After this spell, temperatures are expected to climb again. Both day and night temperatures are likely to remain above normal levels. While June temperatures in UP usually range between 39°C and 41°C, this year they may be 1.5°C to 3°C higher than average. Heatwave days may double this June Experts have warned that heatwave conditions could last much longer than usual. Normally, heatwaves persist for two to three days during June, but this year they may continue for five to six days due to reduced rainfall and higher temperatures. Kharif crops may be affected The weak monsoon is expected to have a direct impact on Kharif farming in Uttar Pradesh. Paddy cultivation, which depends heavily on rainfall during July and August, could be affected if precipitation remains below normal. Delayed sowing and lower yields are also possible for other Kharif crops. El Niño and Pacific storm behind weak monsoon forecast Meteorologists have identified two major factors that could weaken this year's monsoon. 1. Early activation of El Niño The primary reason is the early development of El Niño conditions. El Niño occurs when sea surface temperatures in the equatorial Pacific Ocean become warmer than normal, often resulting in reduced rainfall over India. Scientists had earlier expected El Niño to strengthen later in the season, but it now appears likely to become active from June itself and intensify during August and September. This could reduce rainfall across much of the country, including Uttar Pradesh. 2. Powerful storm in the Pacific Ocean A strong cyclonic storm has also developed in the western Pacific Ocean. According to experts, the system is drawing moisture away from the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal, weakening monsoon winds. As a result, the monsoon is progressing more slowly and may take longer to reach northern states, including Uttar Pradesh.

stories.summary: अगले साल होने वाला उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा बेहद रोचक हो सकता है। क्योंकि सूबे के सियासी नक्शे से लगभग गायब हो चुकी बसपा एक बार फिर से अपनी मौजूदगी का अहसास कराने की तैयारी में जुट गई है। मायावती की कोशिश पुराने और जनाधार वाले नेताओं को बसपा में वापस लाना है। पिछले 10 सालों में कई दिग्गज नेता पार्टी से दूर जा चुके हैं। कुछ ने खुद पाला बदल लिया, जबकि अधिकांश को मायावती ने बाहर किया। 2007 में मायावती की जिस टीम ने यूपी में 206 सीटें जीतकर बहुमत की सरकार बनाई थी, उसमें से बमुश्किल एक-दो ही आज पार्टी का हिस्सा रह गए हैं। ऐसे में बसपा के लिए पुराने नेताओं को ‘घर’ वापसी आसान नहीं होगी। लेकिन अगर मायावती इसमें सफल होती हैं, तो भाजपा सहित अन्य सभी दलों के समीकरण जरूर बिगड़ सकते हैं।

stories.title: 'Stabbing in the guise of friendship will not be tolerated':CM Yogi speaks on Surya murder case; warns against cow slaughter
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Monday referred to the recent murder of Surya in Ghaziabad and said that violence carried out under the guise of friendship is unacceptable. He added that parents who fail to correct their wayward children are making a mistake. Addressing a gathering in Bijnor, the Chief Minister said that non-violence and compassion are virtues of humanity, but action must be taken against those who indulge in wrongdoing. Referring to Hindu scriptures, he said people should be gentle with the virtuous but firm with those who commit crimes. Remarks on cow protection Responding to demands from some groups to declare the cow the national animal, Yogi said that cows are revered as a mother in Indian culture and do not require any formal declaration to establish that status. He criticised people who, according to him, post pictures of cows on social media while extending Bakrid greetings. The Chief Minister warned that cow slaughter is strictly prohibited in Uttar Pradesh and said anyone attempting it would face serious consequences. Targets opposition over citizenship issue Yogi accused opposition parties, including Congress and the Samajwadi Party, of opposing measures intended to help persecuted minorities from neighbouring countries. He said the government had acted to provide relief to such communities and questioned the opposition's stand on the issue. Questions silence on treatment of Hindus in neighbouring countries The Chief Minister also questioned why religious leaders had not spoken out about the condition of Hindus in Pakistan and Bangladesh. He claimed that the Hindu population in both countries had declined significantly over the years and criticised what he described as a lack of public condemnation of such developments. Strong remarks on Pakistan During his speech, Yogi accused Pakistan of mistreating religious minorities and said India had acted to address the concerns of displaced Hindu, Sikh and Jain families. He also issued a warning against any attempts to disturb peace and security within India. Recruitment now based on merit, says CM Highlighting development projects in Bijnor, Yogi said a medical college, highways and railway projects had been established due to sustained development efforts. He added that thousands of youths from the district had secured police jobs and claimed that recruitment is now conducted transparently and on merit. Land deeds distributed to displaced families The Chief Minister visited Alampur Gawdi in Bijnor's Afzalgarh area, where he distributed land ownership documents to 1,645 Hindu families who had migrated from Pakistan and to 50 former servicemen. Earlier this year, he had also distributed land ownership certificates to families displaced from Bangladesh in Lakhimpur Kheri. Background: Surya murder case Surya was allegedly stabbed to death by Asad in Ghaziabad on May 28. Police later arrested multiple accused in connection with the case and said one suspect remains absconding. Authorities have also initiated action against a house linked to the accused, alleging that it was constructed on illegally occupied land. A notice has been issued seeking a response from the family within 15 days.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Bulldozer action planned on Asad's home in Ghaziabad; Rahul slams government over CBSE re-evaluation process more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. Rahul Gandhi slams govt over CBSE re-evaluation costs says, 'Beware of pickpockets' Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Monday questioned the Centre and the CBSE over the answer sheet verification and re-evaluation process. In a post on X, he wrote, “Students are being forced to pay extra money just to ensure that their own answer sheets are evaluated correctly. If marks are wrongly awarded due to a CBSE error, why should students and their families bear the burden?” 2. Bulldozer action proposed against murder accused's house; notice served in Ghaziabad Five days after Class 11 student Surya Chauhan’s murder in Ghaziabad’s Khoda area, authorities served a notice on the house of main accused Asad’s father, alleging illegal occupation of government land. Officials warned of demolition action if the encroachment is not removed within 15 days, while police continue searching for the absconding accused. 3. Yogi's remark on merit list sparks attention; 223 UP toppers honoured Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath honoured 223 Class 10 and 12 state board toppers in Lucknow, joking that girls dominate merit lists because boys are busy with household chores. He also urged students to avoid excessive smartphone use and focus on learning and discipline. 4. Commercial LPG cylinders costlier by up to ₹53.50 Commercial LPG cylinder prices have been increased by up to ₹53.50 from June 1, adding to operating costs for restaurants, hotels and catering businesses across the country. The price revision comes as part of a series of changes taking effect at the start of the month. 5. UP plans 6 nuclear power plants to meet rising electricity demand Uttar Pradesh plans to set up six nuclear power plants with a combined capacity of 8,400 MW to meet growing electricity demand. Most projects are proposed in Purvanchal, with NTPC, IOC and the Adani Group showing interest. The state is also preparing its first nuclear power policy. 6. Mayawati launches BSP comeback drive, reaches out to former leaders BSP chief Mayawati has begun efforts to bring back former party leaders and strengthen the organisation ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The move aims to rebuild the party’s Dalit, Muslim and Brahmin support base, with several former MPs and MLAs reportedly in touch with the BSP. 7. Iran says US clearly not complying with ceasefire Iran’s Parliament Speaker and lead negotiator, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, has accused the US of breaching its ceasefire agreement with Iran, including by continuing its blockade of Iranian ports and failing to restrain its ally Israel from escalating attacks in Lebanon. 8. Devkinandan Thakur says Hindu lives have become ‘cheaper than petrol’ Religious preacher Devkinandan Thakur sparked controversy during a discourse in Gujarat, claiming that the lives of Hindus and cow slaughter have become “cheaper than petrol and diesel”. Referring to the Ghaziabad murder case, he called for greater Hindu unity and also welcomed Muslim groups reportedly supporting the demand to declare the cow as ‘Rashtra Mata’. 9. Thunderstorm, rain alert in 63 UP districts; winds may reach 70 kmph The weather department has issued a yellow alert for thunderstorms and rain across 63 districts of Uttar Pradesh, with wind speeds expected to reach 40–70 kmph. Recent storms claimed two lives in Lucknow and Lakhimpur Kheri, while hailstorms and heavy rainfall brought relief from heat in several districts. 10. South actress makes allegations against Tamil Nadu CM says, 'He was responsible for my miscarriage' South actress and former Bigg Boss South contestant Julie has leveled several serious allegations against actor and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Thalapathy Vijay. She has held Vijay and his party, TMK is responsible for her miscarriage.

stories.title: AAP MP Sanjay Singh clashes with officials in Prayagraj:Asks, 'Is discussing paper leaks a crime?'; two student leaders detained
stories.summary: In Prayagraj on Monday, Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh had a heated confrontation with ADM City Satyam Mishra and DCP Manish Kumar Shandilya. Singh was interacting with students at the Circuit House on alleged paper leaks and irregularities in recruitment examinations when the two officials arrived with police personnel and sought to halt the programme. ADM City Satyam Mishra asked Singh to step aside for a discussion, prompting a sharp response from the AAP leader. Criticising the officials, Singh said: “Am I disrupting law and order that you have come here to stop me? Is discussing paper leaks a crime? You have no authority to enter the Circuit House. Had I been holding a programme on a public road or at a public venue, you could have intervened. You are attempting to undermine the rights and privileges of a Member of Parliament. I will raise this matter before the Privileges Committee.” Singh remained seated and refused to leave the venue. The officials eventually moved to another room in the Circuit House, while he continued his interaction with students on examination-related issues. However, moments later, as Singh stepped outside to address the media, the power supply to the hall was reportedly switched off. Power supply cut during media interaction After the meeting ended, Sanjay Singh stepped outside to speak to the media. According to him, the electricity supply in the hall was cut off at that time. He expressed displeasure over the administration's actions and said such discussions could not be stopped. Two student leaders detained Police detained student leaders Pankaj Pandey and Ashutosh Pandey, coordinators of the United Competitive Students Hunkar Manch. Ashutosh was present at the Circuit House during the event, while Pankaj was detained near Jahaj Chauraha in the Karnalganj area. Both had participated in a student protest held on May 29. Students angry over recruitment exam irregularities Students in Prayagraj have been protesting against alleged irregularities in the UP Daroga and Lekhpal recruitment examinations. On May 29, more than 2,000 competitive exam aspirants staged a demonstration, alleging paper leaks and demanding greater transparency in recruitment exams. The students demanded the release of the UP Daroga recruitment scorecard, cancellation of the Lekhpal examination, transparent recruitment processes, and strict action against those involved in paper leak cases. They have also announced a "Chalo Lucknow" march on June 12. Three coaching institutes sealed after protest Following the May 29 demonstration, authorities sealed three coaching institutes—Exampur Wala Coaching, Super Climax Coaching, and Target On Coaching—alleging involvement of their teachers and students in the protest. Commenting on the action, Sanjay Singh accused the government of trying to divert attention from examination-related failures. He said the focus should be on ensuring fair and transparent examinations rather than taking action against coaching institutes.

stories.title: Rape survivor climbs tower with 3-year-old tied to her back:Alleges police inaction despite FIR; descends after 6 hours on DM's assurance
stories.summary: A rape survivor climbed an 80-foot-high mobile tower in Uttar Pradesh's Gonda district on Monday with her three-year-old son tied to her back, alleging that police had failed to arrest the accused despite an FIR being registered. The incident triggered panic in the area and drew a large crowd. Senior officials, including the ADM and ASP, reached the spot and spent nearly six hours persuading the woman to come down. She finally descended after District Magistrate Priyanka Niranjan assured her that action would be taken. Climbed tower with son tied using saree According to locals, the woman, a resident of a village under Tarabganj police station limits, entered the premises of Raghukul Vidyapeeth School around 9 am. She tied her son to her waist with a saree and climbed the mobile tower installed on the campus. She sat at a height of about 50 feet and refused to come down despite repeated appeals from police and administrative officials. Woman alleges accused still at large During the rescue operation, the woman spoke to CO City Anand Rai over the phone from the tower. She alleged that a man from her village had raped her and that although an FIR had been filed, the accused had not been arrested. She further claimed that the accused continued to harass her and that she had repeatedly approached police and senior officials seeking action. Police send water and biscuits for child Concerned for the safety of the child, police personnel climbed partway up the tower and provided water and biscuits. Fire brigade and police officials remained engaged in talks with the woman for several hours. The woman told officials that she had made multiple visits to Gonda and Lucknow regarding her complaint and had submitted several applications to the authorities. Descends after DM's intervention Police also arranged a video call between the woman and the accused's mother, who urged her to come down and assured support. However, the woman remained adamant. The standoff ended only after District Magistrate Priyanka Niranjan personally spoke to her and assured her that appropriate action would be taken. Following the assurance, the woman safely climbed down from the tower along with her son.
